notes: The manifest is durable runtime configuration. The stable server only interprets route/source/style/script metadata; all page-owned code remains on runtime. Ice Dragon is opt-in and persisted locally. Generated Ice Dragon artwork hydrates from browser-safe base64 text assets. The juvenile companion is used for the sidebar brand, assistant avatars, and new-chat welcome orb. The adult guardian is applied directly to the live Chat message chamber by ice-dragon-art-loader-v3.js using inline !important background longhands so the theme stylesheet's !important shorthand cannot override it. Chat boot stays behind the hydration guard until account-scoped state and, when relevant, Ice Dragon art are ready or the bounded fail-open timer expires. Pending stream request metadata is persisted locally so Chat can reattach to replayable server-side LALM generations after page backgrounding, reload, or return.
